name: Parchment Epic
tagline: Aged parchment, engraved line drawings that etch themselves, and wide-tracked serif headlines under sunburst rays.
description: Documentary-explainer style for histories, origin stories and big-idea narratives. Warm parchment with a vignette and grain, thin dark-brown engravings (clock faces, rose windows, arcades, compass geometry) that draw themselves stroke by stroke, Cinzel all-caps headlines with one deep-red accent word, radiating sunburst rays behind the hero, HUD-style corner metadata with an era counter and a red progress rule, and a dark opening scene with a golden glowing title.

display.usage: All-caps headlines 74–150px, tracking 0.08–0.12em; the huge red year counter at 400px

mono.usage: HUD metadata and kicker lines 11–26px, uppercase, tracking 0.3em

transitions: hard cut between parchment plates; each plate redraws from blank
dark-to-parchment cut after a glowing dark opener
HUD frame and red progress rule persist across every parchment plate
textAnimations: headline rises 26px while tracking tightens 0.16em → 0.08em, 0.9s power3.out, 0.22s line stagger
glow title resolves from blur(14px) and scale 1.08
big red number ticks between values (years, counts) with power2.inOut
kicker and italic captions fade up 10px

rhythm.notes: Four plates: cold open, hero engraving, date counter, title card. Each plate spends its first second drawing, then holds while hands, rays or counters keep moving slowly.

guide:
- Look only: build the user's own subject in this visual language; don't reuse the example's scene.
- Parchment plates are a radial gradient #eee3c8 → #e2d1ad → #c9b28a with a brown vignette and an feTurbulence grain layer (multiply, ~0.3 opacity). Dark beats are #140d06 with a gold #f6d38a title and stacked orange text-shadows that resolves from blur(14px) and scale 1.08.
- Headlines: Cinzel 700 uppercase, 74–150px, tracking 0.08em, one short line in ink #2a1d12 plus one accent word in red #a3221b. They rise 26px while tracking tightens 0.16em → 0.08em, 0.9s power3.out, 0.22s line stagger. Narration is italic Cormorant Garamond 500, 34–40px, fading up 10px.
- Draw the subject as an inline SVG engraving in #3b2a1a: 1.2–2.4px strokes with pathLength=1, outer structure first, then detail, power2.inOut over 0.9–1.6s with small staggers. Add flat red or blue fill (~0.8 opacity) only after the strokes finish.
- Put a 96-ray sunburst (#6b4a26 at 0.13 opacity) behind the main element and rotate it linearly a few degrees per plate. Keep something moving slowly on every plate (rays, a counter, part of the drawing) so nothing is static.
- Keep a HUD frame on every parchment plate: 30px corner brackets 40px in, IBM Plex Mono 11–26px uppercase labels tracked 0.3em in #5b4630 in the four corners (chapter, series, era or place, plate number) and a 640px red progress rule that fills linearly across the whole piece.
- Hard cuts between plates; each plate redraws from blank, spends its first ~1s drawing, then holds while the slow motion continues.
- Optional motif: one huge red Cinzel number (≈400px: a year, count or stat) that ticks between values with power2.inOut while an engraving draws over it.
- Avoid modern sans type, pure white, photos and saturated colour beyond the single red.
example: The preview is a documentary opener about the history of clocks: a glowing cold open, an engraved town clock drawing itself under sunburst rays, a red year counter, and a series title card. Don't copy this scene unless asked.
